info.title: islam.museum static JSON API
info.description: Read-only JSON files generated from the museum's knowledge graph at build time. There is no runtime server: every response is a static file. Prose is CC BY-SA 4.0; structured data is CC0 1.0. See https://github.com/amado2k5/islam-museum/blob/main/docs/data/README.md.
